Dakatarwa tana riƙe saƙonnin yanzu da na gaba; Ci gaba yana sake gwada saƙonnin da ke jira yanzu. Sokewa tana cire saƙonnin da aka sa a jira har zuwa lokacin buƙatar. Idan ana aikawa, sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba. Ba za a iya janye saƙon da ake aikawa ba, kuma ana iya maimaita isarwar da ba a tabbatar da ita ba. Rashin nasara na dindindin da ƙoƙarin da ya kai iyakar sake gwadawa suna nan don dubawa. Sake gwada saƙonnin da suka gaza yana fara sabon zagayen ƙoƙari kuma yana kiyaye dakatarwar da take akwai.
email-recovery-empty: Babu saƙonnin da ke jira ko masu karɓa da aka dakatar.
email-recovery-failed: Ba a iya tabbatar da aikin ba. Sabunta jerin jira kuma sake gwada aikin ɗaya idan ya zama dole.

email-recovery-unavailable: Ba a iya karanta jerin jiran imel ba. Duba damar mai gudanarwa da samuwar sabar.

Don kawo su tare, ba da adireshin sabis da bayanan shiga: ana amfani da su don wannan shigo da kawai, ana aika su zuwa adireshin kawai, kuma ba a taɓa adana su ba. Bar shi babu komai don shigo da ba tare da fayilolin ba.

import-board-instruction-asana: Liƙa JSON na fitarwar ayyukan Asana ({ "data": [...] } daga fitarwar Asana ko GET /tasks). Ana haɗa ayyuka cikin sassa (memberships); ayyukan da aka kammala su koma An gama.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: A Businessmap (wanda a da ake kira Kanbanize), buɗe Advanced Search, zaɓi Configure results don zaɓar ginshiƙai, sauke fayil ɗin Excel, sannan ka zaɓi wannan fayil ɗin .xlsx. Ana karanta ginshiƙai da sunayensu na Turanci (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): idan asusunka yana amfani da wani harshe, sake suna layin kanun zuwa Turanci da farko. Column yana zama jerin abubuwa kuma Lane layuka; masu su, tambari, launi, kwanaki, sharhuna da mahaɗan iyaye suna kiyaye wurarensu, kuma Priority, Size, Type da sauran ginshiƙai suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu.
import-board-instruction-clickup: A ClickUp, fitar da ayyuka a matsayin CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, ko fitar da List ko Table view tare da dukkan ginshiƙai), sannan ka liƙa CSV ɗin. Matsayi suna zama jerin abubuwa, jerin ClickUp suna zama layuka, kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna tare da ƙananan ayyukansu, waɗanda aka ba wa, tambari, kwanaki, fifiko da lokaci.
import-board-instruction-csv: Liƙa Ƙimomi Masu Rabuwar Waƙafi (CSV)/Ƙimomi Masu Rabuwar Tab (TSV).
import-board-instruction-deck: Liƙa JSON na allon NextCloud Deck (allo mai "stacks", kowane stack yana ɗauke da "cards"). Stacks su zama jerin, cards su zama katuna.
import-board-instruction-excel: Zaɓi takardar .xlsx irin ta WeKan (ginshiƙai iri ɗaya da fitarwar Excel: Take, Bayani, Matsayi/Jeri, Mambobi, Lakabai, kwanakin wata, filaye na musamman). Layi na farko shi ne take.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Buɗe fayil ɗin .boardarchive daga kundin da aka matse, sannan manna abin da ke cikin board.jsonl na allo, tare da layin sigar ko ba tare da shi ba. Siffar haɗawa rukuni-rukuni ta kallon allo tana zama jerin abubuwa, sauran siffofin zaɓi suna zama alamomi, tubalan rubutu da akwatunan alama suna zama bayani da jerin dubawa, kuma ana riƙe sharhi. Ba a shigo da hotuna da haɗe-haɗe.
import-board-instruction-issues: Liƙa jerin JSON na batutuwan __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Batutuwa su zama katuna da aka haɗa cikin jerin Buɗe / Rufe.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Liƙa JSON na fitarwar Kanboard: abu mai "columns" (ko ayyuka masu column_name) da jerin "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Ginshiƙai su zama jerin, ayyuka su zama katuna.
import-board-instruction-kanri: A Kanri, buɗe Import & Export kuma zaɓi Export individual board (ko Export all data), sannan ka liƙa fayil ɗin .json. Ginshiƙai suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma katuna suna zama katuna, tare da bayaninsu, ranar ƙarshe, tambari da launuka; ayyukan kati suna zama jerin dubawa. Daga fitar da dukkan bayanai ana shigo da allon farko.
import-board-instruction-leo: Manna tsarin Leo (fayil .leo). Ƙwayoyin matakin farko sukan zama jerin, ’ya’yansu sukan zama katuna masu amfani da jikin ƙwayar a matsayin bayanin, ƙwayoyin da suka fi zurfi kuma sukan zama jerin dubawa. Ana shigo da ƙwayoyin da aka yi wa alama a matsayin an gama.
import-board-instruction-linear: A Linear, fitar da batutuwa a matsayin CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, ko fitar da wani view), sannan ka liƙa CSV ɗin. Matsayi suna zama jerin abubuwa, ƙungiyoyi suna zama layuka, kuma batutuwa suna zama katuna tare da wanda aka ba wa, alamomi, kwanaki, babban batu, fifiko, ƙiyasi, aiki da zagaye.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Manna jerin ayyuka na markdown (al'adar da kayan aikin markdown-kanban kamar Obsidian Kanban ke amfani da ita): taken "## Sunan jeri", tare da abubuwa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" a ƙasa. Taken suna zama jerin sunayen kuma abubuwa suna zama katunan; jeri mai sauƙi na maki ba tare da akwatin duba ba shima ana shigar da shi, a matsayin katunan buɗe.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: A MeisterTask, danna sunan aikin, zaɓi Export project kuma fitar da CSV, sannan ka liƙa shi. Sassa suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna, tare da bayanin kulansu, ranar ƙarshe, wanda aka ba wa da tambari; ayyukan da aka kammala suna kiyaye ranar kammalawarsu. CSV da aka rubuta don shigo da MeisterTask na kansa shi ma yana aiki.
import-board-instruction-monday: A monday.com, buɗe menu na allo, zaɓi More actions da Export board to Excel (tare da updates da subitems idan kana so), sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗin .xlsx. Ginshiƙin Status yana zama jerin abubuwa kuma ƙungiyoyi suna zama layuka; mutane, kwanaki, timeline da tambari suna kiyaye wurarensu, sauran ginshiƙai suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu kuma updates suna zama sharhuna.
import-board-instruction-notion: A Notion, buɗe rumbun bayanai a matsayin cikakken shafi, zaɓi ••• da Export, zaɓi Markdown & CSV, kuma zaɓi fayil ɗin .zip da ya sauke, ko CSV ɗaya na rumbun bayanai daga ciki, ko liƙa wannan CSV. Ginshiƙin mai suna Status yana zama jerin abubuwa (idan babu shi, ginshiƙin farko da ya yi kama da zaɓi ne, kuma rahoton shigowa yana faɗin wanne); layuka suna zama katuna tare da takensu, tambari a matsayin alamomi, mutane a matsayin mambobi, kwanaki, da rubutun shafi a matsayin bayani; sauran ginshiƙai suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu. Ba a shigo da dangantaka, hotuna da abubuwan haɗawa ba.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: A Nullboard, buɗe allon, zaɓi Export this board... daga menu, buɗe fayil ɗin .nbx a editan rubutu kuma liƙa abin da ke ciki. Jerin abubuwa suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma bayanan kula suna zama katuna: layin farko na bayanin kula shi ne taken kati kuma sauran bayaninsa ne. Bayanin kula raw yana samun alamar raw. Fayil mai alluna da yawa yana shigo da allonsa na farko.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: A Obsidian, buɗe fayil ɗin allon Kanban a matsayin Markdown (ko buɗe fayil ɗin .md a editan rubutu), sannan ka liƙa duka. Layukan suna zama jerin abubuwa tare da iyakokin katunansu, katuna suna kiyaye tambarinsu, kwanakinsu, fifiko, filaye da jerin dubawa, kuma Archive yana zama katunan taska.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Liƙa JSON na tarin fakitin-aiki na OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Matsayi su zama jerin, fakitin aiki su zama katuna.
import-board-instruction-opml: Liƙa tsarin OPML, kamar yadda Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq da sauran shirye-shiryen tsari ke fitar da shi. Abubuwan saman matakin suna zama jerin abubuwa, 'ya'yansu suna zama katuna tare da bayanin kula a matsayin bayani, kuma abubuwa masu zurfi suna zama jerin dubawa. Abubuwan da aka kammala ana shigo da su a matsayin an gama.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Liƙa fayil ɗin Org mode, kamar yadda Emacs, Orgzly ko Beorg ke rubuta shi. Kanun saman matakin suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma kanun mataki na biyu suna zama katuna. Ana kiyaye TODO da DONE, fifiko, tambari, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE da CLOSED, kuma akwatunan alama da kanun masu zurfi suna zama jerin dubawa.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: A Pivotal Tracker, buɗe shafin MORE na aikin kuma zaɓi Export CSV (ko zaɓi labarai kuma zaɓi Bulk Actions, CSV), sannan ka liƙa CSV ɗin. Kowane matsayin labari yana zama jeri kuma labarai suna zama katuna, tare da nau'insu da alamominsu, masu su, mai nema, kwanaki, sharhuna, ayyuka da masu toshewa; Estimate yana zama Story points kuma zagaye suna zama sprint.
import-board-instruction-plane: A Plane, buɗe Workspace Settings, zaɓi Exports, fitar da ayyuka a matsayin JSON, CSV ko Excel kuma sauke fayil ɗin .zip, sannan ka zaɓi wannan fayil, ko fayil ɗaya daga ciki, ko liƙa JSON ko CSV ɗin. Matsayi suna zama jerin abubuwa, ayyuka suna zama layuka, kuma batutuwa suna zama katuna tare da mai gano su, iyaye, waɗanda aka ba wa, alamomi, kwanaki, mahaɗai da sharhuna; fifiko, ƙiyasi, zagaye da module suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu. Fitarwar Plane ba ta da bayanai ko abubuwan haɗawa, don haka ba a shigo da su ba.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: A Quire, buɗe menu na aikin kuma zaɓi Export CSV, sannan ka liƙa CSV ɗin. Matsayi suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna, tare da ƙananan ayyukansu a matsayin katunan 'ya'ya, waɗanda aka ba wa, tambari a matsayin alamomi, ranakun farawa, ƙarshe da kammalawa, bayani da fifiko a matsayin filin keɓaɓɓe. Sharhuna da abubuwan haɗawa ba sa cikin CSV na Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: A Redmine, buɗe Issues na aikin, zaɓi Also available in: CSV a ƙasan jerin, zaɓi ginshiƙai (All columns, tare da Description) kuma fitar, sannan ka liƙa CSV ɗin. Redmine yana sanya sunayen ginshiƙai a harshenka, don haka saita harshenka zuwa Turanci a My account kafin fitarwa. Kowane matsayi yana zama jeri kuma batutuwa suna zama katuna, tare da tracker a matsayin alama, wanda aka ba wa, marubuci, kwanaki, babban aiki da batutuwa masu alaƙa; fifiko, rukuni, sigar da aka nufa, ƙiyasin lokaci, % Done da filayen keɓaɓɓu suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: A Super Productivity, buɗe Settings, sannan Sync & Backup, zaɓi Export Data kuma liƙa abin da ke cikin fayil ɗin sp-backup .json. Kowane aiki yana zama layi kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna a To Do, In Progress, Backlog ko Done, tare da bayanan kulansu, tambari, ranar ƙarshe, lokacin da aka kashe da ƙananan ayyuka; ayyukan taska suna zama katunan taska.
import-board-instruction-taiga: A Taiga, buɗe Admin > Project > Export kuma sauke juji na aikin (buɗe fayil ɗin .json.gz da farko), sannan ka liƙa JSON ɗinsa. Matsayin user story suna zama jerin abubuwa, user story suna zama katuna tare da ayyukansu a matsayin ƙananan ayyuka, epic da batutuwa suna samun layukansu na kansu, kuma sprint, tambari, sharhuna da halaye na keɓaɓɓu suna zuwa tare. Ba a shigo da abubuwan haɗawa ba.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: A Tasks.org, buɗe Settings, Backups kuma zaɓi Export tasks, sannan ka liƙa abin da ke cikin fayil ɗin .json. Jerin abubuwa suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna, tare da bayanan kulansu, tambari, kwanaki, sharhuna da ƙananan ayyuka; ayyukan da aka kammala suna kiyaye ranar kammalawarsu, kuma fifiko yana zama filin keɓaɓɓe.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Manna sakamakon task export: jerin JSON ko aiki ɗaya a kowane layi. Ayyukan da aka kammala suna zuwa Done, project da priority suna zama alamomi, annotations yana zama sharhi, depends kuma yana zama dogaro da ayyukan da ke toshe su.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: A Teamwork.com, cike samfurin shigo da ayyuka na Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) kuma ajiye shi a matsayin .xlsx, sannan ka zaɓi wannan fayil. Jerin ayyuka suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna; aikin da ya fara da -, # ko > yana zama ƙaramin aiki na aikin da ke samansa (--, ## ko >> mataki ɗaya ƙasa). Waɗanda aka ba wa, kwanaki da tambari suna kiyaye wurarensu; Priority, Estimated time da Complete suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: A TickTick, buɗe Settings, Account, Backup & Import kuma ƙirƙiri ajiyar kwafi, sannan ka liƙa fayil ɗin CSV. Kowane jerin TickTick yana zama layi kuma ginshiƙansa suna zama jerin abubuwa; ayyuka suna kiyaye tambarinsu, kwanaki, jerin dubawa, fifiko da ƙananan ayyuka.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Manna fayil ɗin todo.txt: aiki ɗaya a kowane layi, kamar yadda manhajar todo.txt da manhajojin da suka dace da ita suke rubutawa. Ayyukan da aka kammala ("x") suna zuwa Done, +project da @context suna zama alamomi, (A) yana zama alamar fifiko, sannan due: da t: suna zama ranar ƙarshe da ranar farawa.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: A Vikunja, buɗe Settings, zaɓi Data Export kuma sauke fayil ɗin .zip da yake aiko maka, sannan ka zaɓi wannan fayil, ko liƙa data.json da ke cikinsa. Bokitin Kanban suna zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna, tare da alamominsu, waɗanda aka ba wa, kwanaki, bayani, jerin ayyuka a matsayin jerin dubawa da sharhuna; fifiko, kashi da aka gama da an gama suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu. Ba a shigo da abubuwan haɗawa ba.
import-board-instruction-wrike: A Wrike, fitar da aiki ko babban fayil zuwa Excel, ko cike samfurin shigo da Excel na Wrike, sannan ka zaɓi fayil ɗin .xlsx. Layukan babban fayil da aiki suna zama layuka, Status yana zama jerin abubuwa kuma ayyuka suna zama katuna, tare da Key ɗinsu, babban aiki, waɗanda aka ba wa, ranakun farawa da ƙarshe, dogaro da bayani; Priority, Duration da sauran ginshiƙai suna zama filayen keɓaɓɓu.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Liƙa JSON na fitarwar jerin ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages su zama jerin, items su zama katuna.

r-wrike-workflow-note: Tsarin aiki na Wrike jerin matsayi ne, kowanne a rukunin Active, Completed, Deferred ko Cancelled. Fitarwa tana rubuta jerin abubuwan wannan allo a matsayin ɗaya, mai sunan allon, a cikin JSON da API na Wrike ke dawowa don tsarin aiki: ƙirƙiri wannan tsarin aiki a Wrike kafin shigo da fitarwar Excel ta Wrike na allon, don a yi amfani da matsayinsa. Shigowa tana karanta wannan JSON da aka liƙa a sama, daga WeKan ko daga GET /workflows na Wrike, zuwa allon da aka zaɓa: matsayin da ba shi da jeri yana zama jeri, kuma doka tana alamta kati a matsayin an kammala lokacin da aka matsar da shi zuwa matsayin Completed ko Cancelled kuma ba a kammala ba a matsayin Active ko Deferred. Ba za a iya fitar da dokokin aiki da kai na Wrike daga Wrike ba.
